/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have happ {α : Type} {a b c d : List α} (ha : a.Subset c) (hb : b.Subset d) :
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_append] at hx ⊢
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact Or.inl (ha hx)
    · exact Or.inr (hb hx)
  intro h
  induction h <;> simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case quant => exact happ (by assumption) (by assumption)
  case app =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · intro x hx
      exact hx
    · next Hfalse =>
      have hp : IsOldPred _ → IsFvar _ := by assumption
      specialize hp ?_
      constructor
      cases hp
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    · exact happ (by assumption) (by assumption)
  case ite => exact happ (by assumption) (happ (by assumption) (by assumption))
  case eq => exact happ (by assumption) (by assumption)
EOF
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"
